name: Regular I Iso Left
purpose: The same isolation block the other way. The Z stays where he is, so this runs away from our strength — which is exactly why it is open.

QB.rule: Reverse pivot, hand to the tailback at four yards, then clear out and fake wide.

FB.note: Move him any direction — just move him.

TB.rule: Take the handoff at four yards, get downhill behind the fullback, and cut off his block.

coaching_points: Running away from the Z means one fewer blocker out there, so the tailback has to get north fast.
Their defense will usually shade toward our Z. That is the reason this play exists — check it before you call it.
Same block, same read as I Iso Right. Do not teach it as a new play, teach it as the same play flipped.
